description: This Java class 'DragToMoveTouchListener' provides a custom touch listener implementation for handling drag gestures on a View. It tracks touch events, manages pointer IDs, and invokes a callback with the movement deltas when dragging occurs.

classes.name: DragToMoveTouchListener
classes.description: A touch listener for views that detects drag movements and executes a callback with the delta movement values.

classes.name: OnMoveCallback
classes.description: Functional interface defining a callback method 'onMove' which is invoked with horizontal and vertical movement deltas.

methods.name: DragToMoveTouchListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener with a callback to be invoked on drag movements.

methods.name: onTouch
methods.description: Handles touch events, manages pointer IDs, and detects drag gestures, invoking the callback on movement.
